title: The Nightmare of Responsibility: VO recording script
notes: Play order. "main" lines are his voice (and the Nightmare, a separate voice, VO_NM_*); "optional" lines are the intro/ending cards and the battle narrator box, voiced only if you want narration.
SAY = said aloud, under his breath. THINK = inner voice, close-mic and intimate.
Energy 1 (barely there) to 5 (full effort). length_s is the intended length, not a hard limit.
